dataset: CDC Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data (HRD) Metrics by Jurisdiction
query: jurisdiction='AR'; fields weekendingdate, jurisdiction, totalconfc19newadm, totalconfflunewadm, totalconfrsvnewadm
access: public CDC Socrata API; weekly update
notes: The target is next-week admission pressure. Missing pathogen-period values are not treated as zero; each pathogen has its own valid transition panel.
